effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` WETH (Base 0x4200…0006) to the vault via transferFrom, which spends the signer's WETH allowance to the vault.
The vault supplies that WETH to Morpho Blue markets in its supply queue.
`receiver` gets reETH vault shares; the number is computed from the share price after fee accrual and has no minimum.
formats.shown: Intent 'Deposit', the WETH amount deposited, the share ticker reETH and the address that receives the shares.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many reETH shares the receiver gets; the contract computes it from storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol deposit: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);` The descriptor has no shares field, only 'Share ticker' raw `$.metadata.constants.vaultTicker`.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor. ERC4626 deposit has no minimum shares parameter.

findings.title: deposit intent 'Deposit' names no asset; the signer must read the fields to learn WETH leaves.
findings.evidence: descriptor deposit format: `"intent": "Deposit"`; the asset is only in field 'Deposit asset' (tokenAmount, token underlyingToken).
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Deposit WETH into reETH vault".

effects: The signer sends WETH to the vault via transferFrom; the amount is computed (rounded up) from `shares` and the share price, with no maximum in the call.
The vault supplies that WETH to Morpho Blue markets.
formats.shown: Intent 'Mint', 'Deposit asset: WETH' as a raw ticker, the number of reETH shares minted and the address that receives them.

findings.title: mint does not show how much WETH leaves the signer; the contract computes it with no cap.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol mint: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil); _deposit(_msgSender(), receiver, assets, shares);` Descriptor shows only `"label": "Deposit asset", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"`.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor. Only the signer's WETH allowance bounds the amount.

findings.title: mint shows 'Deposit asset: WETH' with no amount, which can read as an incomplete amount field.
findings.evidence: descriptor mint format: field 'Deposit asset' with raw value `WETH` and no amount; the WETH amount is computed in MetaMorpho.sol mint.
findings.fix: Change the label to "Pays with (amount set by vault price)" or change the intent to "Mint reETH shares, paid in WETH".

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns reETH shares from `owner` (rounded up from `assets`); when owner is not the signer, it spends owner's share allowance to the signer.
The vault withdraws WETH from Morpho Blue markets.
formats.shown: Intent 'Withdraw', the exact WETH amount, the receiver and the owner whose shares pay.

findings.title: withdraw does not show how many reETH shares the owner burns; the contract computes it from storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol withdraw: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil);` The descriptor has no shares field.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor. ERC4626 withdraw has no maximum shares parameter.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` reETH from `owner`; when owner is not the signer, it spends owner's share allowance to the signer.
The vault withdraws WETH from Morpho Blue markets.
`receiver` gets WETH; the amount is computed (rounded down) from the share price, with no minimum.
formats.shown: Intent 'Redeem', the reETH shares burned, the receiver and the owner; nothing names the asset that the receiver gets.

findings.title: redeem never names WETH as the asset the receiver gets, though mint and deposit show it.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol redeem → ERC4626._withdraw sends `asset()` (WETH) to `receiver`. Descriptor redeem fields: 'Shares to redeem', 'To', 'Owner' only; no `underlyingTicker` field as in mint.
findings.fix: Add a field `{"label": "Receive asset", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"}` or change the intent to "Redeem reETH for WETH".

findings.title: redeem does not show how much WETH the receiver gets; the contract computes it with no minimum.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor. ERC4626 redeem has no minimum assets parameter.
